mapper.select: SELECT GRP_ID, GRP_NAME FROM TB_EOS_CODE_GRP ORDER BY GRP_ID
SELECT GRP_ID, CODE, CODE_NAME, SORT_ORD, USE_YN FROM TB_EOS_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND GRP_ID = #{grpId} ORDER BY SORT_ORD, CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EOS_CODE_GRP (GRP_ID, GRP_NAME, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTM) VALUES (#{grpId}, #{grpName}, #{regUserId}, #{regDtm})
INSERT INTO TB_EOS_CODE (GRP_ID, CODE, CODE_NAME, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTM) VALUES (#{grpId}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{sortOrd}, #{useYn}, #{regUserId}, #{regDtm})
mapper.select: SELECT POLICY_ID, POLICY_TYPE_CD, POLICY_KEY, POLICY_VAL, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DTM FROM TB_EOS_POLICY WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL AND POLICY_TYPE_CD = #{policyTypeCd} ORDER BY POLICY_TYPE_CD, POLICY_KEY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EOS_POLICY (POLICY_ID, POLICY_TYPE_CD, POLICY_KEY, POLICY_VAL, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DTM, USE_YN, CHANGE_REASON, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTM) VALUES (#{policyId}, #{policyTypeCd}, #{policyKey}, #{policyVal}, #{effectiveFromDtm}, 'Y', #{changeReason}, #{regUserId}, #{regDtm})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EOS_POLICY SET EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM=#{effectiveToDtm}, USE_YN='N' WHERE POLICY_TYPE_CD=#{policyTypeCd} AND POLICY_KEY=#{policyKey} AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL
